normalization_rule: To compare W/B to shell mass per enclosed volume, first declare the same reference displaced-air density, geometry/volume and inclusion boundary. W/B times that density has kg/m3 dimensions; this paper performs no conversion or fresh estimate. Whole aircraft closure additionally needs the complete installed inventory, carried-state accounting and application-specific lift/pressure assumptions.
verification_plan_distinction: The verification plan separately quotes an approximate kg/m3 equivalent. That is a quoted equivalence claim in that document, not the native dimensionless Metlen ratio; its normalization state and derivation require traceable source evidence before reuse. Retain both source contexts without silently identifying their numerical values or adopting either as a measured capsule density.

dry_allowance_definition.interpretation: Configured whole non-water dry allowance; a model assumption, not a measured aircraft mass. Nitrogen inventory and carried water require their own state/boundaries; dry equipment and tankage are distinct from contents.

existing_complete_budget.method: Read existing generated fields only; no budget generator rerun or new estimate. floor/credible/demonstrated are source-policy columns with mixed evidence classes; demonstrated is not a flown aircraft.

verification_plan_E1: Weighed closed, skinned, sealed cell including its joints and share of inter-cell structure; declared enclosed volume, pressure/load state, leak/outgassing and geometry/packing applicability. Existing StageA design and StageB test are prospective; this paper authorizes no physical action and selects no acceptance tolerance.

source.section: E1 — what a sealed vacuum cell actually weighs

verification_plan_E1_published_falsifica.published_text_verbatim_joined_lines: **What would falsify the concept.** A Stage A breakdown above ~0.7 kg/m³ per cell with no path below it — because packing then takes the effective figure over the wall.
verification_plan_E1_published_falsifica.scope: Existing conditional concept-screening statement for the StageA sealed-cell design breakdown and the source packing hypothesis. It is not a new selected acceptance tolerance, a measured test result, a complete-aircraft closure proof or a rule converting the two literature source bases.
